metadata.description: Claude Code mods from the Cottage Arcade: games to play while Claude works, arcade skins, and guards for the house rules.

plugins.name: announcer
plugins.description: The Shore of the Ancients announcer calls green test streaks.

plugins.name: cabinet-spinner
plugins.description: Spinner words and end-of-turn lines from the game you work on, and arcade tokens.

plugins.name: creel
plugins.description: A bobber while a long command runs, and a Reel It In fish when it ends.

plugins.name: loon-chicks
plugins.description: Subagents swim as Loon Echo chicks above the prompt.

plugins.name: tilt-sensor
plugins.description: The house rules as a pinball tilt: DANGER after an edit, TILT on a commit.

plugins.name: wanted-level
plugins.description: Crimson Rogue stars for risky moves; five stars blocks the next one.

plugins.name: task-breakout
plugins.description: The open OpenSpec tasks as a brick wall; a checked box breaks a brick.

plugins.name: attract-mode
plugins.description: A Primordia Lenia dish grows in a pane when the session is idle.

plugins.name: full-tilt
plugins.description: The Full Tilt pinball table in a pane, with the real physics.

plugins.name: photo-booth
plugins.description: The screenshots a QA run saves, in a pane.
